head: Windows 11 November update KB5132061: what's new
dek: Microsoft's November security update for Windows 11, KB5132061, installs automatically and adds a setting to change the right-click menu, with faster performance in apps like Edge and Firefox.
details: On Windows 11 26H2 it's build 26300.9974, on 25H2 build 26200.9974. Only 25H2 and 26H2 still get updates for Home and Pro on most PCs; support for 24H2 Home and Pro ended in October.
means: Your PC updates by itself; check that you're on a supported version.
todo: Open Settings > Windows Update and restart if the update is waiting; check your version under System > About.
